item.title: How to test async code in React
item.description: Testing asynchronous code in React components ensures data fetching, API calls, and delayed updates work correctly. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve tested countless async operations in production applications. React Testing Library provides async utilities like waitFor, findBy queries, and proper handling of promises and timers. This approach creates reliable tests for components that fetch data, handle loading states, and manage async operations.
